retrievalProfile.description: A maximalist digital collage blending a gritty Old West town with a vibrant, glowing cosmic nebula sky and high-impact 3D chrome typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composite featuring central figures in ornate western/rock attire positioned in a dusty frontier town, set against an impossible, glowing green and gold galactic sky with massive 3D metallic lettering floating above.
coreVisualRelationships: Juxtaposition of earthy wooden textures and ethereal cosmic gases
Scale contrast between small background figures and dominant central subjects
Depth created by 3D extruded text floating in the mid-ground
Color harmony between the green nebula and the warm desert tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two primary subjects are centered and large-scale in the foreground, with smaller secondary characters flanking them in the mid-ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive 3D chrome logo at the top center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright chrome text, move down to the central faces, then outward to the town details and nebula.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with textures, characters, and celestial patterns.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep greens and golds in the celestial sky
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm browns and ochres of the wooden buildings and dirt road
colorSystem.accentColorRole: High-key white chrome reflections and bright red clothing details
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky contrasts with the more naturalistic but high-contrast lighting on the subjects.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a thick, fluid script with heavy 3D extrusion
Secondary text uses a wide, geometric sans-serif with perspective warping
Extrusions follow a consistent downward-facing perspective
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is stylized as a vertical dollar-sign-like symbol with horizontal bars
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Fluid, organic 3D script paired with rigid, wide geometric sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Light rays emanating from behind the text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the primary logo's fluid but massive presence

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a digital composite of a dusty 1800s western town street with wooden buildings under a vibrant, glowing green and gold nebula sky filled with stars. Place characters in flamboyant western-rocker costumes in the foreground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large 3D chrome script logo at the top center with deep downward extrusion and a wide sans-serif subtitle below it, both featuring metallic textures and light-ray effects.

verificationChecks: Is the sky a vibrant green nebula?
Is the main text heavily extruded 3D chrome?
Is the setting a western town?
Are the characters wearing ornate, non-traditional western gear?

adjustableVariables: Density of the background town details
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original title

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of sky and town

postGenerationChecks: Check for metallic sheen on 3D text
Ensure the nebula glow interacts with the town edges
Verify the perspective of the 3D extrusion matches the camera angle
Confirm the ampersand-style symbol is distinct
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Western Town Setting] + [Vibrant Nebula Sky] + [3D Chrome Script Typography] + [Theatrical Character Posing].
